g.title: HR_SALARYREVIEWITEM
g.text: Salary Review Item - It’s a compensation item used for the salary review. Example, Base Salary.
The Identifier of the Salary Review Participant record.
The Identifier of the Currency record.
The Identifier of the Compensation Item record.
Base Increase Percentage to be used to calculate the budget amount.
The monetary amount expressed in the selected currency.
The total amount (by Remuneration Type) expressed in System Currency.
Base amount for the selected participant at the Salary Program snapshot date.
Guideline X Value for the selected participant at the Salary Program snapshot date.
Guideline Y Value for the selected participant at the Salary Program snapshot date.
Given X and Y attribute for the selected participant, this is the minimum suggested increase as from the program selected guideline.
Given X and Y attribute for the selected participant, this is the maximum suggested increase as from the program selected guideline.
Salary program status determines, for example, it’s still in a stage where rules are being defined or whether a salary review process has been already lauched.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_SALARYREVIEWPARTICIPANT
g.text: Salary Review Participant - Reference to a person or company relationship who is eligible for a salary review.
The Identifier of the Salary Program Pool record.
The Identifier of the Person record.
The Identifier of the Company Relationship record.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
